title: bug: get_pending_questions (and wait_for_task's pending-question path) treat any non-"human" comment as an agent answer, so a moe-daemon system comment posted after a human question masks the still-unanswered question
description:
Held item from hunt #11 (task-afe61cc0, architect-74d9e1c7, msg-7ed73235), filed by the governor in BACKLOG. There is no live case today. Its fix may touch tools/waitForTask.ts, which task-4fbd3c69 is editing, so it waits on that row. The governor promotes it once 4fbd3c69 is DONE.

PROBLEM. get_pending_questions finds the last comment whose author is not 'human' and treats every human comment after it as unanswered. A comment the daemon posts itself, with author 'moe-daemon' (landing notes, system notices), is therefore taken as an agent's answer. A human question followed only by a daemon comment drops out of get_pending_questions and out of wait_for_task's pending-question surfacing, though nobody answered it.

EVIDENCE (at 8ca8d389):
- getPendingQuestions.ts:130 `if (comments[i].author !== 'human') {` (the "last agent comment" scan), then :136-139 `.filter((c) => c.author === 'human')` after it.
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-afe61cc0/B/zzHuntB_pendingMasked.test.ts with its .output.txt. "still surfaces the human question when only a moe-daemon comment follows it" fails, "Tests 1 failed (1)".

FIX DIRECTION.
- Skip system authors (moe-daemon, and any other daemon-authored id) when looking for the last answering comment.
- Apply the same rule wherever wait_for_task or taskPayload derive pending questions, so the two surfaces agree.
definitionOfDone: A human question followed only by moe-daemon comments still appears in get_pending_questions and in wait_for_task's pending-question surfacing. A human question followed by a real agent comment is still treated as answered.
The ported hunt repro passes, and the existing get_pending_questions and wait_for_task test files stay green in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.

Its only dependsOn, task-4fbd3c69, reached DONE at 21:13:58Z (landing 67d7a0c0).
